rating_change_obtained.meaning: battleElo obtained a rating change amount change and direction flag negative from Elo.ratingChange for one party after a single battle
rating_change_obtained.checkpoint: before applying the update to eloA and eloB

negative_flag.meaning: direction flag negative returned by Elo.ratingChange

elob_should_decrease.meaning: negative is true so eloB's rating should decrease per Elo.ratingChange semantics

elob_should_increase.meaning: negative is false so eloB's rating should increase per Elo.ratingChange semantics

dependent_ratings_correct.meaning: protocol functionality relying on the calculated Elo ratings operates on correct (not entirely incorrect) rating data
dependent_ratings_correct.checkpoint: after the rating update is consumed by dependent functionality

assumptions: battleElo is invoked to process a single battle and applies the returned change and negative to eloA and eloB.
The negative=true and negative=false branches are alternative scenarios; the claim covers whichever branch applies.
Downstream harms (rankings, matchmaking, rewards) are conditional on other functionality relying on these ratings.

unresolved.description: Report does not give numeric rating values or the exact per-branch update equations as a comparable quantity relation; the direction correspondence is represented by grounded Boolean observables rather than an arithmetic equality.

limitations: The impact's downstream consequences (distorted rankings, unfair matchmaking, mismatched rewards) are not individually formalized; only the incorrect-data condition is bound.
No concrete prior rating state or executed battle transaction is asserted, so the plan is symbolic.
The direction correspondence is encoded via Boolean observables because the report omits numeric rating values and exact update arithmetic.
